label: Episode 42
logline: Emerging from the smoke of the shattered cathedral gates in full ducal regalia, Alexander confronts Rupert, wins the loyalty of the royal guards, and is proclaimed the rightful Duke of Ashburn by his weeping mother.
continuity_notes: Directly follows Episode 41 where Alexander's forces breached the cathedral entrance; Alexander now steps through the ruins, halting the wedding and unmasking Rupert's illegitimate reign.
notes: no clip met the brief; best effort returned

picks.logline: Emerging from the smoke of the shattered cathedral gates in full ducal regalia, Alexander confronts Rupert, wins the loyalty of the royal guards, and is proclaimed the rightful Duke of Ashburn by his weeping mother.

picks.transcript:
CLIP: episode 42, 2 segment(s), 38s
-- segment 1: 00:18.00 to 00:40.05 --
[00:18.00-00:21.20] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Furious, Hysterical): "Guards! Arrest this imposter!"
[00:21.50-00:23.40] CAMERA: Medium shot of the royal guardsman standing rigidly in red uniform and bearskin cap, resting his white-gloved hand on his sabre.
[00:22.00-00:23.40] ROYAL GUARD (Stoic, Defiant): "We will not."
[00:23.40-00:26.50] CAMERA: Close-up on Rupert, veins bulging in his neck as his composure shatters.
[00:23.50-00:25.20] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Screaming, Outraged): "I said arrest him!"
[00:25.50-00:26.50] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Desperate, Unhinged): "Why?!"
[00:26.50-00:28.80] CAMERA: Close-up on the Royal Guard holding his upright blade with unwavering conviction.
[00:26.70-00:28.80] ROYAL GUARD (Firm, Reverent): "Because we know who he is."
[00:28.80-00:30.40] CAMERA: Medium shot of Catherine clutching her father's arm, her bridal bouquet drooping as panic seizes her face.
[00:29.00-00:30.30] CATHERINE (Trembling, Apprehensive): "Rupert..."
[00:30.40-00:33.80] CAMERA: Medium close-up of Rupert gripping the edge of a pew for balance, his eyes wild with terror.
[00:30.50-00:33.80] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Denial, Shaken): "You cannot be him. Alexander died!"
[00:33.80-00:39.90] CAMERA: Wide tracking shot behind Alexander as he advances down the center aisle, silhouetted against the ruins of the cathedral nave.
[00:34.00-00:39.80] ALEXANDER (Cold, Commanding): "And yet, here I stand. That is the lie you built your life upon."
[00:39.90-00:40.05] CAMERA: Medium shot of an elderly silver-haired woman in simple ivory robes stepping into the aisle, her hands outstretched in trembling awe.
-- segment 2: 01:02.00 to 01:17.80 --
[01:02.00-01:04.00] ALEXANDER (Tender, Resolute): "I have come home, Mother."
[01:04.00-01:12.50] ACTION: Alexander's mother turns toward the gathered nobility and guards, raising her chin and pointing proudly toward Alexander.
[01:04.20-01:12.40] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Ringing, Authoritative): "Let everyone hear me! This is my son... Alexander Ashburn. The rightful Duke of Ashburn!"
[01:12.50-01:13.80] CAMERA: Medium shot of Rupert cowering on the altar steps beside Catherine and her father, utterly defeated.
[01:13.80-01:17.80] CAMERA: Tight close-up on Alexander, his hand resting on the hilt of his sabre as his eyes burn with fierce, cold retribution.
[01:13.80-01:17.50] ALEXANDER (Grim, Vengeful): "And now, Rupert... we settle what you stole."
